name: Agbor
summary: First-party English and local-context discovery, Delta State official route inspection, and national OSGOF route inspection established cadastral custodianship and service/procedure evidence but no public Agbor parcel feature endpoint. No geometry sample is retained.
queryOutcomes: English discovery found official Delta State land-service material and OSGOF cadastral pages. The local-context query used Ika/Delta terminology; official results were in English and did not expose a local-language parcel service. Exact query text and URLs are recorded in city-6727-agbor.json under freshResearch.
requestOutcomes: All executed GET routes and outcomes are recorded in city-6727-agbor.json under requestOutcomes. Official pages loaded, but no parcel schema/CRS/native ID plus geometry response was exposed. The DeltaMap route was checked and identified as an unrelated ARK game map.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Delta State Ministry of Lands, Survey & Urban Development; official state material ties Agbor to land planning/registration and identifies archives/registry and LIS/GIS work, but does not expose a public parcel layer.
sourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Office of the Surveyor-General of the Federation; official pages document national surveying/mapping, cadastral/legal survey, and cadastral GIS responsibilities.
sourceAssessment.scope: Custodian and procedure evidence only; coverage and machine-readable parcel access unresolved.

geometryRetention.reason: No verified safe parcel ID+polygon response.

scopeLimits: No Agbor-local public parcel viewer/API or native parcel schema was verified.
Official state/national custody and budget/procedure references do not establish citywide open parcel coverage.
The WUP point [6.24875754589369, 6.19484525731121] was preserved exactly and not used to infer absence.

Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: A future official Delta State or local GIS publication may expose Agbor parcel data, but its endpoint, scope, fields, CRS, native identity, and coverage are currently unknown.
